name: The Seattle Times editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Seattle Times Center (low confidence, Oct. 2026). Largest Washington daily, owned by the Blethen family. The board endorses in both parties' races and has long opposed a state income tax; in 2026 it endorsed an independent over a Democrat in one legislative race.

name: The Stranger Election Control Board
lean_basis: Seattle alt-weekly; self-described progressive and openly partisan in tone. Its endorsement guide is widely used by Seattle voters.

name: League of Women Voters of Washington
lean_basis: Nonpartisan civic organization. Does not endorse candidates; takes positions on ballot measures based on member-adopted League positions. Its president co-signed the pamphlet statements against IL26-001 and IL26-638.

name: Washington State Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its website says the state party does not endorse candidates; county and legislative-district Democratic organizations do.

name: Washington State Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. In 2026 it issued 'official recommendations' in the nonpartisan Supreme Court races and urges a YES on all three initiatives.

name: Washington State Labor Council, AFL-CIO
lean_basis: Statewide labor federation; endorsements are voted by delegates from affiliated unions and skew Democratic. Its president co-signed the pamphlet statement against I-645.

name: Association of Washington Business
lean_basis: The state's chamber of commerce and largest business association; opposes new taxes and endorses pro-business candidates of both parties.

name: Washington Education Association
lean_basis: Statewide teachers' union; endorses mostly Democrats. Its president co-signed the pamphlet statement against I-645.

name: Washington State PTA
lean_basis: Nonpartisan parent-teacher association; takes positions on education-related measures through member-adopted legislative principles. Does not endorse candidates.

name: Planned Parenthood Alliance Advocates (Washington)
lean_basis: Abortion-rights and LGBTQ+ advocacy arm of Planned Parenthood in Washington; endorses candidates and measures. Its state director co-signed the pamphlet statements against IL26-001 and IL26-638.

name: ACLU of Washington
lean_basis: Civil liberties organization; does not endorse candidates but takes positions on measures affecting civil rights.

name: Let's Go Washington (I-645 sponsor)
lean_basis: Conservative initiative committee funded largely by hedge fund manager Brian Heywood; sponsored the 2024 initiatives and gathered the signatures for I-645. Listed so readers can see the sponsor's own case.

name: Washington House Republicans (caucus)
lean_basis: The Republican caucus of the state House; hosts explainer pages supporting the 2026 initiatives. Does not endorse in judicial races.
